title: Pumpkin and Stew Curry
description: A delicious and spicy Thai-style curry made with pumpkin, stew meat, and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced stew and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced portuguese and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced pumpkin and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped sour and stir to combine.
Stir in 2 tbsp of Thai red curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in 2 cups of coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10-15 minutes or until the pumpkin is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
Garnish with chopped cilantro or scallions, if desired.
